Name: Hispanic Alex for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of AllegedMexican's Hispanic Alex mod for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods

This mod edits the sprite and portrait and a few other things to make Alex hispanic. Also, check the config.json file for an option to change his name to Alejandro!
Also, check out my hispanic George mod at: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4987

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!

Downloads.Description:
Don't forget to endorse the mod!
Still want Alex -- just different ethnicity? Turn his name change off in config.json
